title: simulate-structured: simulate must walk the IR with structured per-step output (no real execution)
description: Feature P1-12. Master §75 example shows simulate emitting a structured simulation_report with steps: [{index, kind, action_id, mock_output, suspension_reason}]. Today vb_cli/src/commands/workflow/mod.rs:95-125 simulate_workflow is a structural dry-run with no state, no mocks, no execution. The output is unstructured (free-text summary). AI agents using simulate for planning need structured output. This bead walks the IR with a for_each_node iterator and emits a JSON simulation_report. For Do nodes, mock_output is null. For Wait/Ask, suspension_reason is the timeout_ms. No Runtime, no Shard, no journal. Note: no P0-4 dep — this is purely structural; no real execution.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL walk the compiled IR and emit one entry per step with {index, kind, action_id, mock_output, suspension_reason}
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT execute any action, allocate any resource, or write to the journal during simulate

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user runs `vb simulate workflow.yaml --emit yaml`
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit a simulation_report with steps: [...] and a top-level summary {total_steps, max_suspension_ms, mock_action_count}

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a step in the IR is a Do node
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit mock_output: null (no real execution)

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a step in the IR is a WaitUntil or WaitEvent node with timeout_ms = N
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit suspension_reason: 'timeout_ms: N'

unwanted.condition: IF simulate is called on a workflow that references a missing action
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT execute the action to 'find' it; it must emit mock_output: null and a top-level note 'action lookup deferred to runtime'
unwanted.because: Simulate is a planning tool; runtime concerns are out of scope

unwanted.condition: IF simulate is called on a workflow with 10,000 steps
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT block on per-step evaluation; it must emit all 10,000 entries in O(n)
unwanted.because: Simulate is for AI planning; latency scales linearly

preconditions: Workflow YAML compiles to a CompiledWorkflow (passes gate 2 = shape)
postconditions: Each entry has: index (u32), kind (string), action_id (Option<ActionId>), mock_output (Option<SlotValue>), suspension_reason (Option<String>)
Top-level summary has: total_steps, max_suspension_ms, mock_action_count
invariants: No Runtime, Shard, FjallJournal, or ActionExecutor is constructed during simulate
The output is deterministic: same input workflow produces the same simulation_report

happy: simulate_emits_one_entry_per_compiled_node: a 5-step workflow produces 5 entries in steps
simulate_do_node_has_null_mock_output: a workflow with 2 Do steps produces 2 entries with mock_output: null
simulate_wait_node_has_timeout_ms_suspension_reason: a workflow with WaitUntil { timeout_ms: 5000 } produces suspension_reason: 'timeout_ms: 5000'
error: simulate_with_invalid_workflow_returns_validation_error: a malformed YAML fails at parse, not at simulate
simulate_with_zero_steps_returns_empty_array: a no-op workflow produces steps: [] and total_steps: 0
edge: simulate_proptest_output_shape_locks_down_schema: 5 fixtures, all produce the same shape

files: crates/vb_core/src/workflow/types.rs (CompiledNodeKind enum: SetConst, Do, WaitUntil, WaitEvent, Ask, ...)
patterns: Pattern: walking compiled.nodes with for_each_node (used by P1-10 explain-fields)
questions: Should simulate respect the resource contract (max_steps) and emit a 'truncated' marker if exceeded? (Spec: yes; emit total_steps and a 'would_exceed_budget' boolean.)

security_failures.failure: Simulate accidentally executes a malicious action (e.g., a shell-out), exposing the host
security_failures.prevention: Strict separation: simulate is purely structural, never instantiates ActionExecutor
security_failures.test_for_it: simulate_does_not_construct_action_executor (compile-time test: grep for ActionExecutor in the simulate code path)

usability_failures.failure: AI agent reads simulate output but can't tell which steps would suspend (blocking)
usability_failures.prevention: Suspension reason is explicit per Wait/Ask step

data_integrity_failures.failure: Simulate output is non-deterministic (e.g., uses HashMap iteration order)
data_integrity_failures.prevention: Steps are emitted in compiled.nodes order (a Vec), so iteration is deterministic
data_integrity_failures.test_for_it: simulate_output_is_deterministic (assert two runs of the same workflow produce byte-equal output)

integration_failures.failure: External tool expects simulate output to be free-text, breaks on JSON
integration_failures.prevention: Default output is YAML/JSON; free-text is the legacy fallback and is deprecated

phase_0: Read crates/vb_core/src/workflow/types.rs to enumerate CompiledNodeKind variants
phase_2: In simulate_workflow: walk compiled.nodes with a for_each_node iterator
Emit JSON simulation_report with steps: [{index, kind, action_id, mock_output, suspension_reason}]
For Do nodes: action_id = Some(...), mock_output = null
For WaitUntil/WaitEvent/Ask: suspension_reason = 'timeout_ms: N' (or 'no timeout' for WaitEvent without timeout)
For other nodes: action_id = null, mock_output = null, suspension_reason = null
phase_3: Emit top-level summary: {total_steps, max_suspension_ms, mock_action_count, would_exceed_budget}
phase_4: Run `moon run :test -p vb_cli` and verify all new tests pass
Manual: `vb simulate fixtures/issue_triage.yaml --emit yaml | jq .steps[0]` returns the first step

similar_implementations: explain (P1-10) walks the same compiled.nodes; share the iterator

apis_that_do_not_exist: There is no simulation_report struct today; this bead defines it
no_placeholder_values: Do NOT use 'TBD' for mock_output; use null explicitly
